archetypes.name: skill-frontmatter-lint-reviewer
archetypes.rationale: The change touches skill registry autoload text plus a new parser lint, so review should focus on value-length semantics and S017 compatibility.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the plan for the skill description compression and length-cap lint. Check that the lint measures only the description value, preserves existing agent-lint responsibilities, scans both public and dev-only skill trees, and will catch all future over-200 descriptions. Also check that the proposed rewritten descriptions keep useful trigger clauses and stay under the cap. Cite specific plan sections and file paths in your findings. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
